title: Stack-aware branch maintenance
description: Manual isolated production-gateway proof of derived branch inputs, shared SDK replay/push, checkpoint renewal and restart recovery. Requires an existing tmux server; creates one owned detached session.

maintenance.intent: Verify pinned handoff, stale-parent refusal followed by supported replay, frozen merged-publication child ownership, repeated rebases, restart after push and owner renewal. Preserve task and package bytes; grant no approval.

ci_watch.intent: Drive the native CI-fix writer through public CI-watch replay for default and token-less templates, both stacked and retargeted. Preserve retained TASK.md and require the current publication base and lease guard.

inline_terminal.intent: Use an isolated native worker to hold after guarded execute, prove HEAD movement remains pending, then push and emit its own terminal mark. Require the publishing checkpoint to renew before CI-fix context completes.

inline_no_change.intent: A native worker validates a current branch and supplies its own report-backed no-change terminal mark without a push. Retire only the gateway input; preserve checkout, prior checkpoint and approval state.

pushed_terminal.intent: A command worker executes the shared leased push, then fails. Public completion replay must reconcile that real pushed result before retiring terminal input; preserve the failed disposition and grant no approval.
